description: Display user role badge in sidebar user info area. When auth.mode is not 'none' and a user is logged in, show a role badge (Admin/Viewer) next to or below the user email in the sidebar's user info section. The badge should be visually distinct (e.g., colored pill/label). Add proper i18n for the role labels and update Japanese translations.
steps: Install dependencies: run `pnpm install` in the ui/ directory to ensure node_modules are available

Modify ui/src/app/layout/sidebar/sidebar.component.ts: In the existing user info section (the `@if (authService.authMode() !== 'none' && authService.currentUser())` block), add a role badge/pill element between the email display and the logout button. Use TailwindCSS classes for styling - e.g., a small rounded pill with distinct colors: green/emerald for 'admin', blue/slate for 'viewer'. The badge text should use i18n.
Add i18n attributes: Use `i18n="@@sidebar.roleAdmin"` and `i18n="@@sidebar.roleViewer"` for the badge labels in the template. The source text should be 'Admin' and 'Viewer' respectively.
Run `make ui-i18n-extract` from the project root to regenerate ui/src/locale/messages.xlf with the new trans-units
Update ui/src/locale/messages.ja.xlf: Add new trans-unit entries for sidebar.roleAdmin (target: '管理者') and sidebar.roleViewer (target: '閲覧者')
Verify the build compiles with `pnpm exec ng build` in ui/
Run tests with `pnpm run test -- --watch=false` in ui/ to ensure nothing is broken
acceptance_criteria: When auth mode is 'local' or 'oidc' and a user is logged in, their role is displayed as a badge in the sidebar user info area
Admin role shows a visually distinct badge (different color from Viewer)
Viewer role shows a different colored badge
When auth mode is 'none', no role badge is shown (entire user info section is hidden)
The role labels are internationalized with @@sidebar.roleAdmin and @@sidebar.roleViewer custom IDs
Japanese translation file contains translations for the new role labels
The Angular production build (`pnpm exec ng build`) completes without errors
verification: Run `cd /projects/sandbox/mayu/ui && pnpm run test -- --watch=false` and confirm all tests pass
Run `cd /projects/sandbox/mayu/ui && pnpm exec ng build` and confirm build succeeds
Verify i18n entries exist: grep for 'sidebar.roleAdmin' and 'sidebar.roleViewer' in ui/src/locale/messages.ja.xlf
